docs.text: Nutrien Digital Agriculture Centre · University of Saskatchewan

docs.title: What is this portal?
docs.text:
The NDAC Data Discovery Portal lets researchers, collaborators, and partners explore the datasets held by the Nutrien Digital Agriculture Centre (NDAC) at the University of Saskatchewan.

Discovery only — no automatic download

This portal describes what data exists, its scope, and how it was created. Data files are not directly downloadable here. If a dataset is relevant to your work, use the Request Access page to start a conversation with the NDAC team.

docs.title: About NDAC
docs.text:
The Nutrien Digital Agriculture Centre (NDAC) at the University of Saskatchewan develops data-driven tools for precision agriculture and environmental monitoring across the Canadian prairies.

Our datasets cover Saskatchewan, Alberta, and Manitoba and span remote sensing, UAV imagery, soil sampling, crop yield, and wetland mapping.

All data is managed under:

  • Tri-Agency Research Data Management Policy
  • OCAP® Principles (Ownership · Control · Access · Possession)
  • CARE Principles for Indigenous data governance
  • CRDCN standards

docs.title: How the process works
docs.text:
NDAC operates a discovery-first data portal. You explore dataset descriptions here, then contact us if a dataset is relevant to your research or collaboration.

Discover → Review → Inquire → NDAC Triage → Response → (Approval + Conditions)

docs.title: Step-by-step
docs.text:
1. Discover a dataset Browse the dataset catalog and read the dataset page that interests you.

2. Review the documentation Each dataset page includes a summary, spatial/temporal coverage, data types, and access level.

3. Send an inquiry Email Thuan.ha@usask.ca with:

What to include Why Dataset ID (e.g. NDAC-YIELD-001) Identifies the exact dataset Your name and organisation Establishes who is requesting Purpose of the request Helps NDAC assess fit Intended use Required for restricted datasets Preferred timeline Helps prioritise responses Whether collaboration is of interest Opens additional paths

4. NDAC reviews your request We will assess: dataset shareability, sensitivity, partner constraints, and whether a meeting is needed first.

5. We respond Possible outcomes:

  • Share general information only
  • Request clarification or schedule a call
  • Approve access in principle (with conditions)
  • Defer due to restrictions or partner agreements

6. If approved — conditions are documented Approved access includes: permitted files, permitted uses, attribution expectations, and any data-sharing agreement requirements.

docs.title: Access levels explained
docs.text:
Badge Meaning Internal Available to NDAC team members; external access requires discussion Restricted Formal request required; sensitivity or partner constraints apply Approval Required Summary visible; data access needs explicit sign-off Collaborative Accessible to collaborators on active projects

Response time

We aim to respond to all inquiries within 5 business days. Complex requests involving restricted or partner data may take longer.

Contact us →

docs.title: NDAC Data Team
docs.text: Thuan Ha — Data Manager Nutrien Digital Agriculture Centre (NDAC) University of Saskatchewan 📧 Thuan.ha@usask.ca

docs.title: What to include in your message
docs.text:
To help us respond efficiently, please include:

  • The dataset ID you are interested in (e.g. NDAC-YIELD-001)
  • Your name, role, and organisation
  • A brief description of your research purpose or intended use
  • Whether you are seeking a collaboration or a one-time data request

docs.title: About NDAC
docs.text:
The Nutrien Digital Agriculture Centre (NDAC) is located at the University of Saskatchewan. We develop machine learning tools and datasets for precision agriculture and environmental monitoring across the Canadian prairies.

Our data management practices follow:

  • Tri-Agency Research Data Management Policy
  • OCAP® Principles
  • CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance
  • CRDCN Standards

docs.title: Browse All Datasets
docs.text:
13 datasets are currently listed in the NDAC Data Discovery Portal. Use your browser's search (Ctrl+F) or the search bar above to filter.

🏞️ Prairie Annual Cropland Mask and Frequency Surfaces

Annual 10 m cropland mask products with frequency and stability summaries used as foundational layers for downstream analyses.

Active Internal Coverage: Prairie region Period: 2017-2024 Formats: GEE asset, TIFF, CSV 🌿 Kochia Ground Truth and Training Samples

Labeled point samples for kochia and crop classes used for model development, validation, and temporal separability analysis.

Validated Restricted Coverage: Agricultural sites in Saskatchewan and surrounding prairie study areas Period: 2020-2024 Formats: CSV, SHP, GEE table asset 🗺️ Kochia Annual Probability Maps

Annual prediction surfaces representing kochia occurrence probability generated from satellite and embedding-based workflows.

Research Use Approval Required Coverage: Prairie crop regions Period: 2020-2024 Formats: GEE asset, TIFF ⚙️ NDAC Data Infrastructure and Workflow Documentation

Operational documentation describing storage locations, compute environments, transfer workflows, and analysis tools used across NDAC projects.

Living Doc Internal Coverage: Not spatially applicable Period: Living documentation Formats: MD, PDF, DOCX, PPTX 🌱 Downscaled Surface Soil Moisture at 10 m

Prairie soil moisture prediction dataset produced by downscaling SMAP surface moisture using multisource optical, radar, terrain, and soil predictors.

Experimental Collaborative Coverage: AB, SK, MB Period: 2024 growing season (May-June focus) Formats: TIFF, CSV, GEE asset 🧪 Pedon Soil Property Samples and Predictors

Sample dataset linking pedon observations with environmental predictors and embeddings for random forest soil property modeling.

Validated Restricted Coverage: Prairie region sample locations Period: Compiled multi-year reference set Formats: CSV, GEE asset ✈️ UAV Multispectral Imagery Archive

Archived UAV missions and processed imagery products supporting site-scale agricultural monitoring, weed mapping, and calibration activities.

Mixed Restricted Coverage: Selected field sites including Saskatchewan research locations Period: 2021-2024 Formats: TIFF, JPG, ZIP, CSV, PDF 💧 Annual Wetland Probability and Summary Products

Modeled annual wetland probability layers and derived persistence summaries developed from DUC-linked sampling and prairie remote sensing inputs.

Active Internal Coverage: AB, SK, MB Period: 2017-2025 Formats: GEE asset, TIFF, CSV 🌾 Prairie Yield Multi-source Modeling Dataset

Integrated dataset combining satellite, environmental, and derived variables to support crop yield modeling and embedding workflows.

Active Internal Coverage: Prairie provinces (sample project sites in SK, AB, MB) Period: Multi-year; active focus 2020-2025 Formats: TIFF, Zarr, JSON, CSV, PT 📁 PPSN yield data

Yield survey

Processed By Request Coverage: Prairies Period: 2020-2024 Formats: 📁 Prairires cropmask

Crop mask predicted from AlphaEarth and AAFC data

Draft Internal Coverage: Period: Formats: TIF, XML, ZIP, TXT 📁 Yield data at RM and Risk Area
